title: Threshold Geometry Mapping
objective: Map the topological and geometric properties of the destabilization surfaces and metastable boundaries detected during the FV-2 verification.

mapping_tasks.description: Calculate the curvature of the admissibility basin boundary near the S_C threshold to identify 'sharp' vs. 'soft' transition zones.
Compute the gradient of S_C with respect to local budget B_A and pressure P_stab to determine the sensitivity of stability to resource depletion.
Classify transitions as first-order (discontinuous collapse) or second-order (continuous drift/branching) based on observable signatures.

success_condition: A formal geometric representation of the MT-LAW-A stability boundaries is established and consistent with empirical results.
